runtime_contract: selected full-body SHA-256 with external rel32 operands normalized, route-window hashes, relative table entry/thunk/conditional-branch target checks, exact import targets and internal call targets
capture_preconditions: Capture must occur before original SET22 while the native controller gate is held. A runtime adapter must prove the live controller/interface/WLC/cfg identity and bounds, reject invalid field and IE extents, copy IE bytes into owned storage, and retain no child-owned pointer past the synchronous call. These static guards do not authorize raw memory reads.

current_bss_layout.scope_note: Pinned allocator and copy code establishes the sampled layout and backing sizes; static guards do not authorize dereference, prove live pointer validity/lifetime, or establish IE allocation readability. Runtime must perform bounded reads and an owned IE copy before original SET22.

4331.interface_resolution: AirPort_Brcm4331::getVirtIf at 0xc2e0 validates the supplied OSObject against list head controller+0x500; accepted object has wlcif at +0x188

copy_producer.ie_copy: old IE allocation freed, fields cleared, exact source IE length allocated and copied

wlc_start.stored_result: same successful attach result stored in controller+0x418 (WLC base) and controller+0x420 (the WLC pointer used by child state gates)

43224.inline_record: wlc+0x2f8, 0x98 bytes; extent fits the pinned 0x3b98 allocation

copy_producer.ie_copy: frees old wlc+0x360 IE, clears pointer/length, copies record then allocates/copies source IE bytes

capture_provenance.note: Offsets and allocator/copy behavior are fixed-sample static evidence. They do not prove a future adapter's pointer came from this allocation or remains valid while read.

set22_to_worker_closure.scope_note: Dispatcher prefixes, selected command table entries/cases, setter-to-dispatch calls, complete disable functions, the 43224 _wlc_down body/calls, and direct worker callsites are pinned. The whole dispatcher body, _wlc_bsscfg_down bodies, upstream BSD request gate and live instance ownership are outside this child-only guard.

teardown_publication_guards.boundary: The selected function bodies, raw source UUID/SHA, exact imports, and all direct internal call targets are guarded. This proves sampled ordering only; runtime serialization still depends on the separately established outer mutation scope.

4331.sync_handoff: Runtime RouteSymbol admission resolves _wl_event_sync as a named child-image symbol at 0x16c10; the _wlc_bss_mac_rxframe_event call at 0x4efd4 is pinned to that target. For this event-code-3 input, the checked compare/conditional branch reaches the mismatch return epilogue at 0x16c3c, then the caller continues to event queue insertion
4331.boundary: Only the event-code-3 mismatch/return path is guarded. The 0x20 willRoam branch and any higher-level event consumer are outside this check.

43224.state_zero_route: _wlc_assoc_timeout state 0 emits _wlc_bss_mac_event(event code 3, detail 2), which constructs and enqueues an event
43224.boundary: Selected child functions pin event construction and queue handoff only; no higher-level event consumer or reconnect behavior is checked.

idle_timeout_event_scope.claim_boundary: These static guard prerequisites do not independently validate the runtime idle no-op implementation or establish that no event is queued, no callback is pending, or no later consumer can reconnect.

not_guarded: Static guards do not authorize reads of current-BSS pointers, records, or IE memory and do not prove a live instance's object lifetime.

The full _wlc_ioctl dispatcher is not pinned; selected dispatcher prefixes/table entries/cases, both _wlc_bsscfg_down bodies, the selected 43224 _wlc_down body, cfg-free path on 4331, WLC-stop publication paths, and relevant callsites are guarded.

The 4331 _wl_event_sync 0x20 willRoam branch is not guarded; only the event-code-3 mismatch branch and its return epilogue are checked. No higher-level event consumer or global no-retry property is established.
The child contract does not establish the provider's request gate, runtime adapter ownership, serialized read window, or safe bounded-copy callback.
Runtime lookup and provenance of import target addresses must be supplied by a separately guarded installer path.
No legacy_install integration, kext detour, EFI deployment, boot, or hardware test is included.
required_future_installer_guards: Before original SET22, prove the native controller gate and exact live controller/interface/WLC/cfg chain; validate field and IE bounds and copy IE bytes to owned memory without retaining raw child pointers.

Guard provider SET22 entry and same-stack dispatch so capture and original request share the exact gated lifetime; the child static route guards alone do not authorize the capture read or worker detour.
Resolve and validate the actual loaded import targets before passing them to this verifier.
